<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Rally:</strong> Indian indices surged, with the Nifty 50 crossing 24,750 and the Sensex gaining over 500 points, driven by a sharp decline in crude oil prices and sustained FII inflows.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Institutional Shift:</strong> Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) have reached a record 21% ownership in the Nifty 500, officially overtaking FIIs as the primary holders of Indian equities.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I67</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I68</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>RBI Policy Focus:</strong> The RBI’s three-day Monetary Policy Committee meeting has commenced, with economists widely expecting a repo rate pause as policymakers balance domestic inflation risks against growth concerns.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I41</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude Oil Impact:</strong> Brent crude prices have fallen below $85, providing a significant tailwind for Indian market sentiment and helping to ease inflationary concerns.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W15</a></span></li>
</ul>
